purpose: Teach: 多数決/同封/空席/値打ち/再選/内輪/詰め込み/関空

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロジェクト案、本気で、絶対、多数決、絶対、で、絶対、選ばれましたね
lines.en: The project proposal was selected by majority vote—really, absolutely.
lines.style: Brisk delivery. Clipped, efficient opening. Matter-of-fact tone. No hesitation. Professional efficiency with a faint undertone of satisfaction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様への、本気で、絶対、同封、絶対、お礼状、絶対、ご用意しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're preparing thank-you letters for the clients, absolutely.
lines.style: Cooperative and attentive. Steady, measured pace. Genuine warmth underneath the formality. Respectful without flatness.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 役員、本気で、絶対、空席、絶対、補充、絶対、人事と、絶対、相談しましょう
lines.en: Let's consult with HR about filling the vacant executive position.
lines.style: Clear direction. Measured confidence. Directive but not demanding. The tone of someone who expects to be heard and followed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。中古品の、本気で、絶対、値打ち、絶対、査定、絶対、進めております、本気for、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with the valuation assessment of the used items.
lines.style: Professional update. Steady, reassuring tone. Consistent pace. The voice of someone keeping things on track without fanfare.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 労組役員の、本気で、絶対、再選、絶対、社員から、絶対、ご支持、絶対、いただきました
lines.en: The union officers received strong support from the staff in their re-election.
lines.style: Reflective and measured. Slightly slower pace—allowing the information to register. Respectful weight. The acknowledgment of something significant accomplished.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内情報、本気で、絶対、内輪、絶対、に、絶対、留めて、絶対、おります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're keeping internal information confidential, as appropriate.
lines.style: Assuring and steady. Professional gravity. A slight emphasis on 'keeping'—showing care for the protocol. No apology, just responsible certainty.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業務量の、本気で、絶対、詰め込み、絶対、過剰、絶対、避けましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we're not overloading people with excessive workloads.
lines.style: Gentle directiveness. Slightly slower, with care behind the words. The tone of someone looking out for the team. Open, not harsh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。関空、本気で、絶対、経由の便、絶対、手配、絶対、完了しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've completed the arrangements for flights via Kansai Airport.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Warm, closing tone. A hint of ease—the relief of completion. Professional but genuinely satisfied.
